title: Nuclear Propulsion in Space
summary: A 1968 NASA film from the US National Archives explaining why the US needed a nuclear rocket and how the engine works. It also shows combined nuclear and chemical stages for a manned Mars mission.
why: HN people link it as an old-timey explainer for nuclear thermal propulsion, and as evidence these engines were already built and tested.

quote.text: This video is worth checking out if you haven’t seen it yet.
